title: Atom Adventure 2 · Decay Arithmetic
welcome_lead: Meet the famous isotopes, then balance their alpha and beta decay equations.
meta_desc: GCSE Physics Atomic Structure decay arithmetic — isotopes, nuclear notation and alpha/beta decay equations.
final_note: You met deuterium, tritium, U-235, U-238, C-12 and C-14, and balanced alpha and beta decays.

A drops by 4, Z drops by 2; emits ⁴₂He
A unchanged, Z rises by 1; neutron → proton + electron

walkthroughs.body_html:
Isotopes have the same Z but different A.

Hydrogen has three: protium ¹H, deuterium ²H, tritium ³H — all with Z = 1.

Carbon has stable C-12 and radioactive C-14 — both have Z = 6.

Uranium has U-235 (fissile) and U-238 (more abundant) — both with Z = 92.

In alpha decay, the nucleus fires out a helium-4 nucleus: ⁴₂He.

So the parent loses A = 4 and Z = 2.

Example: ²³⁸₉₂U → ²³⁴₉₀Th + ⁴₂He. Both sides: A = 238, Z = 92. ✓

Another: ²²⁶₈₈Ra → ²²²₈₆Rn + ⁴₂He. ✓

In beta decay, a neutron becomes a proton plus an electron (the beta particle).

So A stays the same and Z goes up by 1. The electron is written ⁰₋₁e.

Example: ¹⁴₆C → ¹⁴₇N + ⁰₋₁e. A: 14 = 14 + 0 ✓. Z: 6 = 7 + (−1) ✓.

mcqs.q: Which pair are isotopes of the same element?
options: C-14 and N-14
He-4 and H-2
O-16 and N-14

mcqs.q: After alpha decay, the new nucleus has:
options: Same Z, A reduced by 4
Z reduced by 2, A reduced by 4
Z increased by 1, same A
Z reduced by 4, A reduced by 2

mcqs.q: Which type of nuclear radiation is most ionising?
options: Thick lead — only lead can stop any radiation.
Gamma is most ionising because it can travel furthest and pass through almost anything.
Alpha radiation — large, doubly charged particles cause the most ionisation per unit distance.
Beta radiation is most ionising because it consists of fast electrons.

mcqs.q: What did Rutherford's alpha-scattering experiment show about the atom?
options: It showed that alpha particles can pass through any material because they are massless.
Most of the atom is empty space, with a tiny dense positive nucleus.
It showed that atoms are solid spheres of positive charge with electrons embedded inside.
Beta radiation is most ionising because it consists of fast electrons.

mcqs.q: What absorber is needed to stop beta radiation?
options: Beta radiation is most ionising because it consists of fast electrons.
Thick lead — only lead can stop any radiation.
A sheet of paper — beta is only slightly more penetrating than alpha.
A few millimetres of aluminium (or similar thin metal sheet).

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Carbon-14”?
options: Radioactive carbon: 6 protons + 8 neutrons, beta emitter
A unchanged, Z rises by 1; neutron → proton + electron
Hydrogen-3: 1 proton + 2 neutrons (radioactive)
Fissile isotope: 92 protons + 143 neutrons

Hydrogen-2: 1 proton + 1 neutron
